data.summary_en: Proposed Skill Schema Transport (SST) post-training framework abstracts new-domain knowledge into skill schemas, transfers them into existing model skill space, replacing trajectory memorization with process reuse. On two 3B instruction-tuned backbones, streaming-domain mean final performance improves 2.53–5.75 points; Qwen-3B MATH stream max forgetting 42.41→7.10 points.
